blocks.text: Filipino-American model Kelsey Merritt is back in the Philippines, this time bringing some of her Victoria’s Secret model friends for a tropical getaway. “Feels good to be back home,” Merritt wrote in a recent Instagram post featuring photos of herself surfing with her friends on Siargao island. The group includes fellow models Sara Sampaio and Jasmine Tookes, as well as actress Georgie Flores. They began their Philippine trip in Manila before heading to Siargao then Amanpulo.
